Game Overview

In Fruit Lines Saga, the core idea is straightforward: challenge your strategic skills in Fruit Lines Saga, where you clear the board by aligning five or more matching fruits. Navigate tricky situations with clever use of Undo, Hammer, and Bombs, and spin the Lucky Wheel for surprise bonuses. Rise to the challenge and climb the global leaderboard!
